acceptance_criteria: Design's cited line numbers/assertion text for EO-004, EO-005, and the ISS-0716 precedent verified against the actual current file
Each proposed replacement assertion confirmed to still meaningfully test the acceptance criterion it covers (not weakened to always-pass)

PASS or FAIL with issues if FAIL; handoff completed per protocol (claim via IN_PROGRESS, then COMPLETED with a real result block)

result.summary: Substance of the design (root-cause recap, cited line numbers/assertion text for EO-004, EO-005, and the ISS-0716 precedent, tenant-scoping strategy, and the 'no production code change needed' claim) all independently verified accurate against the current test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs, lib/letflow/platform/migration_rollout.ex, migration_rollout/rollout.ex (@statuses ~w(running completed), line 39), and req374-tenant-migration-fanout-runner.md §9 OQ-1. However, the design FAILS check (e) of WF-02 Step 1b / code-designer.md's own 'Forbidden' clause: it contains extensive literal .exs code blocks -- not signatures/type shapes -- that are meant to be pasted near-verbatim into the test file. Per the hard-gate rule ('FAIL immediately and completely on any single failed check -- no partial credit'), this alone fails the design regardless of the otherwise-correct analysis.
issues: check (e) violated -- real .exs code blocks present, not signatures/type shapes only: design.md §2.2 steps 1-3 (Repo.all(from o in Outcome, where: ...), all_outcomes_succeeded? = Enum.all?(...), and the full if/else assert branches for the EO-004 replacement)
check (e) violated: design.md §3.1 (literal `assert outcome_for(first_result, good_a.tenant_id).status == "succeeded"` / good_b lines)
check (e) violated: design.md §3.2 (literal Repo.get!/Repo.aggregate code blocks including the full scoped_outcomes_query Ecto expression)
check (e) violated: design.md §4's summary table also embeds literal replacement code in its 'Replacement' column rather than describing the assertion shape in prose

Rework instruction for CODE-DESIGNER: keep every other finding in the doc (root-cause recap, line-number citations, the tenant-scoping strategy per assertion, the 'invariant not literal' approach for EO-004, the no-production-code-change conclusion) -- all independently re-verified accurate and sound -- but rewrite §2.2, §3.1-3.3, and §4's table to describe each replacement assertion's required shape and exact semantics in prose/pseudocode (e.g. 'query every Outcome row for rollout_id; assert the invariant: rollout.status == "completed" iff every queried outcome.status == "succeeded"') without literal Elixir/Ecto syntax or copy-pasteable assert statements. The specificity of WHICH values/invariant to assert must stay -- only the literal code syntax must go; that specificity is exactly what TEST-DESIGNER needs and is not itself the violation.
result.next_action: Rework CODE-DESIGNER: revise lib/letflow/design/iss0829-migration-rollout-test-isolation.md to remove literal .exs code blocks per the issues above, keeping all other content. Re-submit to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR.
